notes.title: New Update to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster Coming Midnight August 15, 2024!
notes.notes:
Misao: Definitive Edition was released back in October 2017, and now it's about to be updated to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster at midnight on August 15, 2024!

Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

No matter if you've already witnessed all the horrors of Misao, or are stepping into the Other World for the first time, we hope you enjoy the newly reborn Misao.

The original Misao: Definitive Edition can still be played after the update. You may choose which version to play upon launch.

After the HD Remaster update, the price of the game will be increased to $9.99. However, the game is currently on sale for 20% off its original price until 9:59 AM August 14, so please grab this chance to buy the game before the price increase!

notes.title: Update Announcement (Ver 1.04)
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Misao: Definitive Edition.
The updates for Ver 1.04 are as follows:

[list]
[*]Option settings will now preserve changes even after closing and reopening the game. 
This change also means that all changes made to option settings will be shared among different save files.
(All settings on all save files will be reset to default upon first launch after installing this update)

[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you, and enjoy Misao: Definitive Edition!

notes.title: Steam Sale! Celebrating the release of The Crooked Man!
notes.notes:
Today we have released "The Crooked Man" developed by Uri Games, the first installment in "The Strange Man" series. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/736570/The_Crooked_Man/

We are also planning to release the other titles in this series. 

To celebrate the launch of this title, we have set some fantastic 2D pixel games from Playism on sale! So please enjoy them all together. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/691450/Misao_Definitive_Edition/

In addition, we would like to introduce the impressions from Sen, the developer of Misao: Definitive Edition, about The Strange Man series.  

[quote]I have played Uri-san’s works going back as far as Paranoiac. The event scripting and narrative framework in each and every title has been exemplary. The atmosphere, so peculiar to this series, immerses you in these worlds the same way a good movie does.
All games in the Strange Man series are fully-fleshed out horror experiences in their own right, but fans of suspense and mystery will find much to like here, too.
The game’s difficulty level has been tuned to provide a satisfying challenge without undermining its intended experience in frustration.
[/quote]

We hope you enjoy it!
